title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.7.8
description:
🔥 Account Warmup Studio: Dedicated tab for mass cookie warmup with randomized authentic human behaviors (feed scrolling, watching videos, checking profiles, safe reactions).
🛡️ Auto-Warmup on ID Creation: Automatically warms up newly created accounts immediately after registration to establish instant trust.
📂 Persistent Search Selection: Ticked accounts in 'Load from History' stay ticked across multiple searches and filters in both Page Studio and Warmup Studio.
